description: Aggregate IP allow/deny lists: merges any mix of IPv4/IPv6 addresses, CIDRs, "a-b" ranges and "ip netmask" entries into the minimal set of CIDR blocks, optionally subtracts an exclude list, reports address counts and tests IPs for membership. For firewall rules, WAF / CDN allowlists and cloud security groups. POST JSON body {items, exclude?, check?}. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ip-range-merge

check.description: IPs to test against the merged result
